One team one dream

Cross River is where we foster ideas, transform fintech and change the lives of individuals around the world, every single day. Our impact gets measured by how happy we are to come to work each day, how gratifying it is to know how many lives we touch and how much we give back. As we continue to grow, we hold tightly to the idea that we do well by doing good. We believe in the power of community, creativity, and talent. Join us as we build the future of finance together.

By the numbers

  • Founded in 2008
  • Over 900 employees
  • In 36 states and 2 countries

Our Values

A bank is often associated with value more than values. We know that our value-add to life is only as meaningful as the values we live by. Without these five essential elements, we could never hope to create anything of real value. With them, we achieve something invaluable.

  • Humility
  • Integrity
  • Creativity
  • Compassion
  • Responsibility

Global Benefits

Be your best self

As an employee, your health and wellness are essential. Cross River covers the entire premium for medical, dental, and vision benefits for eligible employees and their families. Cross River also covers the premium and automatically enrolls all eligible employees in $100,000 life Insurance and $100,000 AD&D coverage. Global benefits include:

  • Retirement planning
  • Employee development fund
  • Ongoing learning and development opportunities
  • Volunteer opportunities
  • Charitable donation matching
